cases.name: ascii; empty=false
cases.source:
events = []
class Export(bytes):
    def __buffer__(self, flags):
        events.append(flags)
        raise RuntimeError('must not export')
    def __bytes__(self):
        raise RuntimeError('must not convert')
source = Export(b'A')
assert str(source, 'ascii') == 'A'
assert source.decode('ascii') == 'A'
assert events == []
